english_description: They will think they inhaled something they should not have.
Gain 1 stack of Sensory Overload each time a drug effect is triggered. Each stack of Sensory Overload increases the miss chance of the next attack. Clear all Sensory Overload after an attack misses.
chinese_description: 每次觸發藥物效果時，獲得 1 層感官過載。每層感官過載使下一次攻擊增加miss機率。攻擊miss後清除所有感官過載。

english_description: Whenever Poison stacks decrease by more than 5, enter Stun for 1 second. After this effect triggers, it has a 3-second cooldown, and the threshold required for the next trigger increases by 10.
chinese_description: 毒層數每減少超過5，進入一秒昏厥期，此效果觸發後有3秒的冷卻並且每次觸發下次需要的數值+10

english_description: Gain 2 additional stacks of Poison each time a drug effect is triggered. For the next 4 seconds, received healing is reduced by 20%. This effect permanently retains 1%.
chinese_description: 每次觸發藥物效果時，額外獲得 2 層中毒。並且接下來 4 秒內，受到的治療效果降低 20%。(此效果會永久殘留1%)

english_description: Whenever the character loses 10 Poison stacks by any means or enters Sober, damage reduction decreases by 10%. If triggered by entering Sober, this effect is doubled.
chinese_description: 當角色以任何方式減少10層毒或者進入清醒狀態時，減傷-10%(如果是進入清醒狀態觸發，效力2x)

english_description: Gain 1 stack of Organ Failure each time a drug effect is triggered. Each stack of organ strain reduces maximum health by 4% until the end of the battle. Stacks up to 20 times (-80%).
chinese_description: 每次觸發藥物效果時，獲得 1 層器官衰竭。每層器官負荷使最大生命值降低 4%，持續到本場戰鬥結束。最多疊加 20 層(-80%)。

english_description: At the start of battle, all drugs trigger at the same time. Their effects are not applied, but Poison stacks are counted; in other words, all Poison is applied once. After this effect, Poison stacks are multiplied by 1.5. Before entering Sober for the first time, detoxification speed is increased. Until the first time you enter Sober, all your drugs stop triggering and you cannot attack.
chinese_description: 戰鬥開始時:所有藥物同時觸發，效果不計算但是毒層數計算(簡單來說就是全部的毒上一次)，此效果後毒層數1.5倍 ; 在進入第一次清醒狀態前排毒速度增加，未進入第一次清醒狀態前，你的所有藥物停止觸發，並且你無法攻擊
